title: Premature Deindustrialization : انعكاسات تفكك التصنيع المبكر على الاقتصادات النامية

items.abstract: <jats:p>What happens when the most dynamic entrepreneurial businesses in a country are effectively born global, or when most advanced production facilities are owned and operated by foreign firms which turn out products invented elsewhere? Is thin industrialization the result of policy failure, or is it systemic and unavoidable? Can it be unwound by neo-nationalists? What impact does this have on working and middle classes and social development?</jats:p>
title: Premature Deindustrialization &amp; Thin Industrialization
